other_conditions: Units must be small or micro manufacturing enterprises that started production on or after 27‑03‑2002 for SC/ST/Women entrepreneurs and on or after 24‑08‑2011 for SC/ST entrepreneurs
The unit must commence production or complete expansion on or after 24‑08‑2011
Second‑hand machinery is eligible only if imported directly by the unit or through an agent and supported by the required import documents
If the same person has two or more industrial undertakings, each unit is eligible as a separate entity provided location, products, and licences/clearances/registrations are obtained separately
For units financed by banks, the subsidy is disbursed through the financial institution; for self‑financed units, it is paid directly to the entrepreneur
Eligibility category noted in source: Women
benefits_summary: 25% subsidy on investment in land, building, plant & machinery up to ₹25 lakhs for women entrepreneurs and up to ₹50 lakhs for SC/ST entrepreneurs.
